decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - GRANT
Reasons:
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 07/09/05 the use of Unit 16 on the Bedfont Trading Estate, Bedfont Road for repairing and storage of equipment used in aircraft was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The use began more than ten years ago and has continued since then. The constituent parts of Unit 16, at the time of this decision were as follows:-
Ten Portakabin structures, measuring 15 sqm (x6), 20 sqm (x1), 27 sqm (x2) and 32 sqm (x1).
Two dutch barns measuring 280 sqm together.
A flat roofed building measuring 96 sqm.
A pitched roof building measuring 240 sqm.
Three metal structures comprising two hoppers and a rectangular frame enclosing two electric motors (disused). The structures were originally part of a concrete batching plant.
An open concrete area used for storage with an area of 3,700 sqm..
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the existing unit comprising a group of buildings and adjoining yard area  used for repairing aircraft equipment together with unrelated and disused structures.
